versions.changelog:
Initial release — bilingual executive assistant for ADHD & anxiety.

- Adapts task recommendations to user’s reported energy (1–10 scale)
- Captures ideas and tasks instantly, without categorization
- Offers escalation reminders before deadlines with proactive task breakdown
- Allows frictionless task suspension with empathetic validation
- Provides morning, midday, and evening check-ins tailored to user rhythm
- Fully bilingual operation (Chinese/English) with automatic language detection
